changes: Use typed Rust report bodies internally and fresh three-field Report dictionaries for callback/takeRecords snapshots. Keep delivery metadata internal and preserve CSP body fields.
Create concrete body snapshots in the callback realm, including callbacks supplied by another window. Keep retained history and network bodies independent of page mutations.
Emit WebXR spatial-tracking policy diagnostics with feature/disposition and script source location. Enforced denial takes precedence; report-only policy does not change access decisions.
Report spatial session requests, including denied optional features, while keeping introspection and viewer-only inline sessions free of spatial-tracking reports.
Preserve independent per-type buffer bounds, document isolation, response-selected destinations and inherited policy restrictions.
Compute nonnegative delivery age and count delivery attempts internally.
scope: Two original asynchronous WebXR reporting cases retain their assertion bodies and headers; a completion reporter is injected after testharness. They run through a trusted loopback adapter, not the full WPT runner or an HTTPS deployment.

All 21 local reporting scenarios and 248 associated checks pass, including exact endpoint counts, independent snapshots, cross-realm callbacks, mixed buffers, source locations, inline features, iframe inheritance and navigation.

The native report-only fixture verifies diagnostics together with a consented lease, stereo submission and clean closure using a private synthetic DomeD host and software GL. No physical headset was tested.
Anonymous Discord/X survival, clean closure and captured appearance were checked. This is not authenticated or whole-site correctness coverage. The X QR overlap remains an accepted non-bug.

Current Reporting drafts define Report and ReportBody dictionaries; Permissions Policy still references a historical interface hierarchy. The adapter preserves concrete dictionary fields without migrating CSP to DOM interfaces. Legacy interface/toJSON compatibility is not claimed.

Broader Reporting API and WebXR conformance remain incomplete: potential iframe policy diagnostics, other feature consumers, endpoint retry/lifecycle behavior and wider device/backend coverage need further work.

retained_failed_runs.result: Corrected the Heap import; release compile checks then passed.
Cross-realm report/body prototype mismatch was corrected by building body snapshots in the callback realm; the final matrix passes.

The local server listen backlog of five delayed the 220-report burst. Increasing fixture backlog to 256 allowed the unchanged first candidate to deliver all 220 reports; no engine delivery workaround was added.
Observer telemetry initially omitted the existing event type field. Corrected the fixture; both diagnostic and final packaged native runs pass.
